source_annotation.prompt: Pick up the bread and place it on the first level of the double shelf.

generation_prompt: The robot uses the hand entering from the lower-right edge to reach the golden bread roll on the tabletop, rest its thumb on it, and curl its fingers around it to lift it. It carries the roll to the lower tray of the two-tier wooden shelf, lowers it onto the slats, opens its hand and withdraws to the right, leaving the roll resting in the lower tray. Keep the camera fixed; preserve robot geometry, physically valid joint motion, and normal gripper opening and closing.

data_quality_gate.rule: Variance of the Laplacian of the luma of the model-view frame (cover-resize to the nearest-aspect 720p-class bucket, center crop); pass if >= 120 third-person, >= 60 first-person.
